description: This file defines the SymbolTable class and related structures for managing shader symbols, including scope handling, symbol declaration, and built-in symbol initialization in a shader compiler context.

classes.name: TSymbolTable
classes.description: Manages shader symbol declarations, scope stack, and built-in symbol initialization for shader compilation.

classes.name: UnmangledEntry
classes.description: Represents an unmangled shader symbol entry with matching logic.

classes.name: SymbolRule
classes.description: Defines rules for symbol lookup and mangling based on shader specifications and resources.

methods.name: initializeBuiltIns
methods.description: Initializes built-in symbols based on shader type, specification, and resources.

methods.name: declare
methods.description: Declares a symbol in the current scope.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a symbol by name and shader version.

methods.name: findBuiltIn
methods.description: Finds a built-in symbol by name and shader version.
